text:
maya: heads up — sampleapp onboarding hit a blocker. REST call to /v1/routes works but JS SDK call fails with 422.

maya: minimal repro:
```bash
# REST (works)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"name":"demo","config":{"cache":true,"priority":0}}'
# returns 200 and route object

# JS SDK (fails)
await client.createRoute({ name: 'demo', config: { cache: true, priority: 0 } })
// throws 422 bad request: "invalid param: config.priority"
```

maya: tried patching the sample app to send explicit numbers for priority but same error. looks like SDK serializes small ints as strings sometimes?

lee: ugh. can you paste the raw request payload the SDK sends?

maya: grabbed it from HAR:
```json
{"name":"demo","config":{"cache":"true","priority":"0"}}
```

sam: there we go — SDK is coerced to strings for booleans/ints when packing into form payload. likely serializer uses Object.toString() in one path.

lee: assigning to investigate. I remember we switched to a lightweight serializer to avoid bundle size, but maybe it skips type coercion checks.

alex: impact? is this only sampleapp or could affect customers? @maya

maya: onboarding for new orgs uses the JS quickstart. If priority ends up as string, server rejects and users get a 422 during createRoute. PLG signup flow broken. :grimacing:

lee: ok will triage. quick note: REST accepts both JSON content-type and strictly typed body; SDK was accidentally sending x-www-form-urlencoded on fallback causing stringification.

sam: good catch. that explains the booleans too. form encoding turns everything into strings.

lee: patch plan:
- detect if headers.content-type === 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' then convert values preserving types
- prefer application/json for route/create endpoints
- add unit test and e2e for sampleapp onboarding path

lee: I have a failing test that reproduces this. pushing PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/934

maya: thanks. would be great to get a hotfix cut. this is blocking a few demos tomorrow.

devops-bot: Incident created: REF-2026-03-23-1 — SDK serializer causing onboarding 422s (priority: P2)

lee: will cut 0.12.4 once CI is green. ETA ~2h.

sam: long-term we should add a small serializer contract test that runs against the real API surface for common objects (route, model, policy). reduce regressions.

alex: +1. can someone add to roadmap/optimize DX backlog? I can prioritize.

maya: workaround for now: in sampleapp add explicit JSON header before calling SDK:
```js
client._httpHeaders['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
await client.createRoute(payload)
```

lee: awkward but works. will mark as temporary in the PR description.

maya: confirmed patch fixes it in my local. thanks all.

lee: publishing patch release now. ping here when done.

devops-bot: Release 0.12.4 published to npm (tag: hotfix) — https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/sdk/v/0.12.4

maya: verified onboarding flow on staging — ✅ all green. closing thread.

alex: nice work team.
